sections.title: Objective of the Game
sections.content: Players try to avoid collecting too many penalty point cards. The goal is to have as few bullheads as possible by the end of the game.

sections.title: Game Setup
list: Four cards are placed face up to form the starting rows.

sections.title: Gameplay
sections.content: The game is played in rounds. In each round, players simultaneously select a card from their hand, reveal them at the same time, and place them in order from lowest to highest according to the rules.

sections.title: How to Play a Card?
list: Cards must be placed in ascending numerical order.
A selected card must be placed in the row where the difference between the last card and the new card is the smallest.
If a sixth card would be placed in a row, the player must take the entire row, and the new card becomes the new starting card.

sections.title: Penalty Points and End of the Game
sections.content: Each card has a number and bullheads; each bullhead counts as one penalty point. The player with the fewest points at the end wins.

sections.title: Important:
list: Players choose and place their cards simultaneously.
Strategy is key: pay attention to other players, not just your own cards!

info.label: Difficulty Level
info.value: Easy to learn but requires strategic thinking
